title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Alder is a scale-up building media apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Fennick.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will improve app performance and stability, review code with the team and work closely with design and product.

A yearly learning budget. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
